born: c. 240 (Latin Library index); the brief says c. 250; not resolved
died: c. 320 (Latin Library index); the brief says c. 325; not resolved
role_place: Rhetor and Latin Christian apologist; wrote the Divine Institutes, the Epitome, and De mortibus persecutorum; addressed the Institutes to Constantine (confirmed by the Institutes' opening chapter). The brief's 'adviser to Constantine' is not checked here.
why_relevant: Latin Christian writer who addresses coercion of religion (N), the Law vs the new covenant (D), and the adverse side (X: pagan objections, divine vengeance on persecutors); no comment on Hebrews as a letter (H).
